req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-012 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} accepts partial payloads and leaves omitted fields unchanged. The violation was in test[8]: it had kind=negative but heuristic=BVA. BVA is a boundary heuristic and must be paired with kind=boundary (for valid boundary) or the out-of-boundary case should use kind=boundary with heuristic=BVA as well (since BVA covers both sides of the boundary). The fix changes test[8] (title at 101 chars, one over max) from kind=negative/heuristic=BVA to kind=boundary/heuristic=BVA, which is correct per ISO 29119-4: BVA includes both the valid boundary point and the first invalid point just outside it, both classified as boundary tests. All other tests are preserved exactly as before.

tests.name: test_partial_update_only_title_leaves_other_fields_unchanged
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists: title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=false
actions: PUT /tasks/7 with payload {"title": "Fixed login bug"} (omitting description and completed)
expected: response description == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.' (unchanged)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r012_ep1.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

db = TestingSessionLocal()
task = models.Task(id=7, title="Fix login bug", description="Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.", completed=False)
db.add(task)
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

r = client.put("/tasks/7", json={"title": "Fixed login bug"})
assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {r.status_code}: {r.text}"
body = r.json()
assert body["id"] == 7
assert body["title"] == "Fixed login bug"
assert body["description"] == "Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith."
assert body["completed"] == False

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
